lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Two thousand four hundred and seventy-five. Delta counts every one, and so do I.
lines.script: [precise, proud] Two thousand four hundred and seventy-FIVE. Delta counts every one... [earnest] and so do I.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: How many SkyMiles is that now?
lines.script: [teasing] How many SkyMiles is that NOW?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Four hundred and twelve thousand.
lines.script: [proud, precise] Four hundred and twelve thousand.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Babe! What are you saving them for?
lines.script: [amused] Babe! What are you [curious, warm] SAVING them for?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Something really special.
lines.script: [dreamy, hushed] Something really... special.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: You said that at three hundred thousand.
lines.script: [teasing, easy] You said that at THREE hundred thousand.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It has to be REALLY special. But I'd have flown here for zero miles.
lines.script: [defensive] It has to be REALLY special. [softening, warm] But I'd have flown here for ZERO miles.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Zero miles. Babe. That's the most romantic thing a Delta person can say.
lines.script: [touched, softly] Zero miles. Babe. That's the most romantic thing [amused] a DELTA person can say.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: All yours. I like that.
lines.script: [warm] All yours. [softly, happy] I like that.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Why is the sky PURPLE? It's two in the afternoon!
lines.script: [alarmed] Why is the sky PURPLE? It's [disbelief] two in the afternoon!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: It's been like that since this morning. I held my soda up to it. It's the exact same color.
lines.script: [easy] It's been like that since this morning. I held my soda up to it. It's the [amused] EXACT same color.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I don't know what it is, babe. But it's pretty grape.
lines.script: [easy] I don't know what it is, babe. But it's pretty... [playful] GRAPE.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Don't make me laugh, I'm scared of it! ...Okay. It's a little grape.
lines.script: [anxious, amused] Don't make me laugh, I'm SCARED of it! [quietly, giving in] ...Okay. It's a little grape.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Something strange happened on Long Island too. A blob of mud with eyes climbed in my mother's kitchen window and ran off with her rhubarb crisp.
lines.script: [excited, rushed] Something strange happened on Long Island too. A blob of mud [amazed, slower] with EYES climbed in my mother's kitchen window and ran off with her rhubarb crisp.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: The mud took Deedee's crisp? Is the mud okay?
lines.script: [concerned] The mud took Deedee's CRISP? [sweet, earnest] Is the mud okay?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: We chased it to the pond. And there was a talking fish as big as a car, wearing her baking tin like a crown.
lines.script: [excited] We chased it to the pond. And there was a talking fish as big as a CAR, [amazed, slower] wearing her baking tin like a crown.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: A talking fish! What did he say?
lines.script: [delighted] A talking fish! [eager] What did he SAY?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: He said "Glub." Then he gave Rose a gold coin.
lines.script: [matter-of-fact] He said... [deadpan] "Glub." [short pause] [brightening, proud] Then he gave Rose a gold coin.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Mud in the kitchen, a talking fish, and now a purple sky. Babe, something fishy is going on.
lines.script: [thoughtful, easy] Mud in the kitchen, a talking fish, and now a purple sky. Babe, something... [playful] FISHY is going on.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The fish was the nicest part!
lines.script: [earnest, protesting] The fish was the NICEST part!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I want to go look at that sky with you. But first I have to feed Bready Mercury. He's been alone for a week.
lines.script: [warm] I want to go look at that sky with you. But first [sheepish] I have to feed Bready Mercury. He's been alone for a WEEK.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: He hasn't been alone. Come on, I'll show you.
lines.script: [warm, hushed] He hasn't been alone. [inviting] Come on, I'll show you.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: So I stayed here with her. I was coming over anyway. I've been feeding Bready Mercury every day.
lines.script: [casual] So I stayed here with her. I was coming over anyway. I've been feeding Bready Mercury [softly, proud] every day.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Every day? Fifty grams of flour and fifty grams of water?
lines.script: [touched] Every DAY? [precise, anxious] Fifty grams of flour and fifty grams of water?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Fifty and fifty. I used your little scale.
lines.script: [reassuring, easy] Fifty and fifty. I used your little scale.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: He got so big he was climbing out of the jar. So I baked a loaf with him.
lines.script: [amused] He got SO big he was climbing out of the jar. [casual, proud] So I baked a loaf with him.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It's perfectly round! How did you get it so round?
lines.script: [amazed] It's PERFECTLY round! [curious] How did you get it so round?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I shaped it on my pottery wheel.
lines.script: [casual, proud] I shaped it on my pottery wheel.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: On the pottery wheel! That's brilliant. Why have I been doing it with my hands?
lines.script: [amazed] On the pottery wheel! That's brilliant. Why have I been doing it [disbelief] with my HANDS?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I make bowls all day, babe. So I made you a bread bowl.
lines.script: [warm, easy] I make bowls all day, babe. So I made you a... [playful] BREAD bowl.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: A bread bowl! Now we need soup.
lines.script: [thrilled] A bread bowl! [snappy, serious] Now we need soup.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Nara, sit.
lines.script: [warm, firm] Nara, sit.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Paw.
lines.script: [warm, firm] Paw.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: He's twice as big as when I left! What have you been doing with him?
lines.script: [amazed] He's TWICE as big as when I left! What have you been [playful, suspicious] doing with him?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I sing to him while I stir. He's Bready Mercury. He needs his music.
lines.script: [easy] I sing to him while I stir. He's Bready Mercury. [matter-of-fact] He NEEDS his music.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Which songs?
lines.script: [curious] Which songs?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: "Another One Bites the Crust."
lines.script: [deadpan] "Another One Bites the... [proud] CRUST."

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: "Don't Stop Me Dough!"
lines.script: [delighted, sing-song] "Don't Stop Me DOUGH!"

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Babe. That's so good. I'm singing that one tomorrow.
lines.script: [impressed, softly] Babe. That's SO good. [easy] I'm singing that one tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's the same purple as the sky! An hour ago it was way up on the hill. Now it's on my lawn!
lines.script: [alarmed] That's the same purple as the sky! An hour ago it was way up on the hill. Now it's [scared, louder] on my LAWN!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Mr. Washington is sitting out on his porch in that. Come on!
lines.script: [urgent] Mr. Washington is sitting out on his porch in that. Come ON!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: What happened in 1979?
lines.script: [gentle, curious] What happened in 1979?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: He just said the same thing again, word for word.
lines.script: [uneasy, quiet] He just said the same thing again... [slowly] word for word.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: He always finishes that story. I've heard it nine times. It ends with gumbo.
lines.script: [fond] He ALWAYS finishes that story. I've heard it nine times. [worried, quietly] It ends with gumbo.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It's not a nice afternoon, Mr. Washington! The air is purple!
lines.script: [alarmed, pleading] It's NOT a nice afternoon, Mr. Washington! The air is purple!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Babe. That cloud has a face. And it just talked to us.
lines.script: [shaken, hushed] Babe. That cloud has a face. And it just... [whispers] TALKED to us.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It's like the mud at my mother's house! I told you they talk!
lines.script: [excited, vindicated] It's like the mud at my mother's house! I TOLD you they talk!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: You did tell me. It's a lot scarier in person.
lines.script: [rattled] You did tell me. It's a LOT scarier [quietly, honest] in person.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The man in the mask jumped out! I jumped higher!
lines.script: [defensive] The man in the mask jumped out! [proud] I jumped HIGHER!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: And it rained popcorn on the whole room. Let's do that to these clouds.
lines.script: [amused] And it rained popcorn on the whole room. [scheming, playful] Let's do that to these clouds.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I don't have any popcorn!
lines.script: [panicked] I don't HAVE any popcorn!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: You don't need popcorn. You just need to be that scared.
lines.script: [encouraging, easy] You don't need popcorn. You just need to be THAT scared.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Oh, I'm that scared.
lines.script: [deadpan, shaky] Oh, I'm that scared.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That doesn't sound like him at all. He tells me how old he is every single morning. He's proud of it!
lines.script: [worried] That doesn't sound like him at all. He tells me how old he is every single morning. [fond, protesting] He's PROUD of it!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: If the smog did this to him, what about everybody on the boulevard?
lines.script: [worried] If the smog did this to HIM, what about everybody on the boulevard?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Miss Odette and Doña Carmen! Come on!
lines.script: [urgent] Miss Odette and Doña Carmen! Come on!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Miss Odette, it's me! Can I get a bowl of gumbo?
lines.script: [bright, hopeful] Miss Odette, it's me! Can I get a bowl of gumbo?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Babe, this is bad. Every time I walk in here she yells "Sit down, you're too skinny!" before the door even closes.
lines.script: [worried, quiet] Babe, this is bad. Every time I walk in here she yells [louder, bossy] "Sit down, you're too SKINNY!" [quiet, worried] before the door even closes.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Miss Odette? I'm sorry to bother you. TNB is standing up, and he's very skinny today.
lines.script: [polite, hopeful] Miss Odette? I'm sorry to bother you. TNB is standing up, and he's [earnest] VERY skinny today.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Nothing. She's just like Mr. Washington.
lines.script: [worried, flat] Nothing. She's just like Mr. Washington.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Babe, the pupusas are burning!
lines.script: [alarmed] Babe, the pupusas are BURNING!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Doña Carmen, I'm so sorry. I'm coming behind your counter. I know nobody's allowed back here.
lines.script: [anxious, apologetic] Doña Carmen, I'm SO sorry. I'm coming behind your counter. [rushed] I know nobody's allowed back here.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I flipped them. I'm ready for the towel. Go ahead.
lines.script: [proud] I flipped them. [bracing] I'm ready for the towel. [brave, quietly] Go ahead.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: She smacks you with that towel if you even look at the griddle.
lines.script: [whispers, awed] She smacks you with that towel if you even LOOK at the griddle.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I know! I've never wanted to be hit with a towel so badly!
lines.script: [desperate] I KNOW! I've never wanted to be hit with a towel [pleading] so badly!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The parking tickets can TALK now? They were bad enough when they were quiet!
lines.script: [outraged] The parking tickets can TALK now? They were bad enough [exasperated] when they were quiet!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: And I moved my car on Monday night! I set two alarms!
lines.script: [indignant] And I moved my car on Monday night! I set [precise, proud] TWO alarms!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Fine. Can I pay it in SkyMiles?
lines.script: [flat, defeated] Fine. [short pause] [hopeful, scheming] Can I pay it in SkyMiles?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Excuse me! She is not a snack. She is our guest!
lines.script: [indignant] Excuse me! She is NOT a snack. [firm, polite] She is our guest!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: We do have snacks, though. I've got half a bag of gummy worms.
lines.script: [easy, helpful] We DO have snacks, though. I've got half a bag of gummy worms.

lines.speaker: Canyon Coyote
lines.text: Coyotes don't eat gummy worms.
lines.script: [offended, dry] Coyotes don't eat gummy worms.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Babe, look at that tree. It's grey. The leaves, the trunk, even the dirt. It looks like an old black and white movie.
lines.script: [uneasy] Babe, look at that tree. It's GREY. The leaves, the trunk, even the dirt. It looks like [awed, quietly] an old black and white movie.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: There's one lemon on it. And the lemon is inside a block of something orange.
lines.script: [slowly, uneasy] There's one lemon on it. And the lemon is inside a block of something... [puzzled] orange.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I've seen this before. There's one exactly like it at my parents' pond, with a dragonfly inside.
lines.script: [tense, quiet] I've seen this before. There's one EXACTLY like it at my parents' pond, with a dragonfly inside.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: On Long Island? Babe, that's three thousand miles away.
lines.script: [startled] On Long Island? Babe, that's [casual] three thousand miles away.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Two thousand four hundred and seventy-five.
lines.script: [snappy, firm] Two thousand four hundred and seventy-five.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: It's not glass, and it's not glaze. I work with this kind of stuff all day and I have no idea what it is.
lines.script: [curious] It's not glass, and it's not glaze. I work with this kind of stuff all day and I have [uneasy, slowly] NO idea what it is.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: There's a little round hole in the side, like somebody took a bite out of it.
lines.script: [puzzled] There's a little round hole in the side, like somebody [uneasy] took a bite out of it.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The one at the pond has the same hole. And you can't pull it off. Rose tried, and then I tried.
lines.script: [matter-of-fact] The one at the pond has the same hole. And you can't pull it off. Rose tried, [sheepish, quieter] and then I tried.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Can I try anyway?
lines.script: [hopeful, easy] Can I try anyway?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Okay. Wow. Your turn.
lines.script: [stunned] Okay. Wow. [short pause] [easy, quick] Your turn.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I already lost to the small one. ...Maybe it's easier in California.
lines.script: [sheepish] I already lost to the SMALL one. [hopeful] ...Maybe it's easier in California.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It's not easier in California.
lines.script: [flat, defeated] It's NOT easier in California.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It's a burnt-out flashbulb. My mother found one exactly like it next to the dragonfly.
lines.script: [uneasy, quiet] It's a burnt-out flashbulb. My mother found one exactly like it next to the dragonfly.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Who leaves the same bulb at a pond in New York and on a hill in Los Angeles?
lines.script: [puzzled, uneasy] Who leaves the same bulb at a pond in New York... AND on a hill in Los Angeles?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I don't know. And I really don't like it.
lines.script: [serious, quiet] I don't know. And I REALLY don't like it.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Me neither. And I like almost everything.
lines.script: [shaken] Me neither. And I like... [deadpan] almost everything.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That hill has EYES! The whole hill just stood up!
lines.script: [startled, shouts] That hill has EYES! The whole hill just stood up!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Babe. I take naps on that hill.
lines.script: [hushed, appalled] Babe. I take... [slowly] NAPS on that hill.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I think you've been napping on his face!
lines.script: [shocked] I think you've been napping [amazed, louder] on his FACE!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I'm so sorry, sir!
lines.script: [mortified, polite] I'm SO sorry, sir!

lines.speaker: The Big Shake
lines.text: RUMBLE. There was a big flash up here this morning, and it woke me up.
lines.script: [deep, rumbling] RUMBLE. [groggy, slowly] There was a big flash up here this morning, and it woke me up.

lines.speaker: The Big Shake
lines.text: A million years under this city, and everybody up top is always leaving. Today nobody leaves. Not ever.
lines.script: [deep, lonely] A million years under this city, and everybody up top is ALWAYS leaving. Today [low, firm] nobody leaves. Not ever.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: He'd know. He has four hundred and twelve thousand miles.
lines.script: [dry, fond] He'd know. He has four hundred and twelve THOUSAND miles.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I'm sorry I kept falling asleep on you. I didn't know you were a person.
lines.script: [sincere] I'm sorry I kept falling asleep on you. I didn't know [sheepish] you were a PERSON.

lines.speaker: The Big Shake
lines.text: I liked the naps. You were the only one who ever stayed.
lines.script: [deep, gentle] I liked the naps. You were the only one [softly, touched] who ever stayed.

lines.speaker: The Big Shake
lines.text: Something shiny has been stuck in my pipe all day. It tickles. Ah... ah... A-CHOO!
lines.script: [deep, rumbling] Something shiny has been stuck in my pipe all day. It TICKLES. [building, louder] Ah... ah... A-CHOO!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It's a gold coin with a lemon on it. Rose's has a dragonfly.
lines.script: [amazed, quiet] It's a gold coin with a LEMON on it. Rose's has a dragonfly.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: The one the fish gave her?
lines.script: [curious] The one the FISH gave her?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yes. A fish gave her one, and now a hill sneezed one at me.
lines.script: [baffled] Yes. A fish gave her one, and now a hill... [disbelief] SNEEZED one at me.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Nara thinks it's a very small frisbee.
lines.script: [amused, dry] Nara thinks it's a very small frisbee.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Nara, I'm sorry. We don't play fetch with gold.
lines.script: [gentle, apologetic] Nara, I'm sorry. We don't play fetch with GOLD.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The hill said a flash woke it up this morning. The fish at the pond said the same thing.
lines.script: [thoughtful, uneasy] The hill said a flash woke it up this morning. The fish at the pond said the SAME thing.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Two flashes, two orange blocks and two gold coins. Babe, I don't love that. Let's go check on Mr. Washington.
lines.script: [careful, slowly] Two flashes, two orange blocks and two gold coins. Babe, [uneasy] I don't love that. [brisk] Let's go check on Mr. Washington.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: That's ten times now. It gets better every time.
lines.script: [fond, amused] That's TEN times now. It gets better every time.

lines.speaker: Miss Odette
lines.text: I brought gumbo for the whole block. TNB! Sit DOWN. You're too skinny!
lines.script: [light Louisiana Creole accent, warm, booming] I brought gumbo for the whole block. TNB! [light Louisiana Creole accent, bossy, louder] Sit DOWN. You're too skinny!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Yes, ma'am!
lines.script: [delighted, obedient] YES, ma'am!

lines.speaker: Doña Carmen
lines.text: And YOU. Who went behind my counter?
lines.script: [light Salvadoran accent, stern] And YOU. [light Salvadoran accent, sharp, slowly] Who went behind my counter?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Thank you, Doña Carmen! That's the best towel I've ever been hit with!
lines.script: [thrilled, grateful] THANK you, Doña Carmen! That's the best towel I've ever been hit with!

lines.speaker: Doña Carmen
lines.text: They came out perfectly crispy. Don't ever do it again.
lines.script: [light Salvadoran accent, grudging] They came out perfectly crispy. [light Salvadoran accent, stern] Don't EVER do it again.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Babe. Gumbo. Go get the bread bowl!
lines.script: [excited] Babe. [snappy] Gumbo. Go get the BREAD bowl!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It has a hole in the top. I gave that piece to Nara.
lines.script: [sheepish] It has a hole in the top. I gave that piece [quietly] to Nara.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: That's not a hole. That's where the gumbo goes in.
lines.script: [cheerful] That's not a hole. That's where the gumbo [playful] goes IN.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: With two thousand four hundred and seventy-five miles in between.
lines.script: [softly, fond] With two thousand four hundred and seventy-five miles in between.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Each way. That's a lot of SkyMiles.
lines.script: [wry] Each way. [warm, happy] That's a LOT of SkyMiles.
